decisions.statement: A caller gets one link table and puts every notification into that table.
The keyboard panel gets a provider apart from the gamepad panel's provider.
A refresh of the keyboard panel refreshes the gamepad panel too.
Loading twice is an error rather than a second library.
The game's own row setup is replaced so a row may have its own icon.
The game reaches the library through two global names for one library.

definition: the rows an addon adds to the game's notifications panel
